en.title: Chinese factories growing again: Domestic demand weak, export engine keeps pace
en.summary: China's manufacturing returned to growth in September after two months of contraction, with production and new orders recovering. Artificial intelligence-related foreign demand is providing primary support while domestic consumption and housing weakness remain economic vulnerabilities.
